statements:
CREATE TABLE "product_deadline_queue" (
  "id" TEXT DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', 1 + (random() & 3), 1) || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))) NOT NULL,
  "row_key" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "use_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "payload" TEXT,
  "state" TEXT DEFAULT 'ready' NOT NULL,
  "attempts" INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "due_at" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,
  "claim_expires_at" TEXT,
  "claim_token" TEXT,
  "last_error" TEXT,
  "created_at" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

statements:
CREATE TABLE "product_timers_deadlines" (
  "id" TEXT DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', 1 + (random() & 3), 1) || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))) NOT NULL,
  "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "base_at" TEXT,
  "armed_from" TEXT,
  "due_at" TEXT,
  "fired" INTEGER,
  "fired_at" TEXT,
  "outcome" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("product_id") REFERENCES "product" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

statements: ALTER TABLE "product" ADD COLUMN "_version" INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL

statements: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "idx_product_deadline_queue_row_key_use_id_name" ON "product_deadline_queue" ("row_key", "use_id", "name") WHERE state IN ('ready', 'claimed')

statements: CREATE TRIGGER "trg_product_bump_version" AFTER UPDATE ON "product" FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW._version = OLD._version BEGIN UPDATE "product" SET _version = OLD._version + 1 WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END
